post.yt_desc:
In 2025 Netflix earned $45.2 billion of revenue and $13.3 billion of operating profit, a 29.5% margin, up from 12.9% in 2019. This video follows the money: the shift from DVDs to streaming, 325 million+ paid memberships, a roughly $18 billion content budget spread across them, and the new engines of ads, paid sharing, live events and price increases, plus the risks, including the Warner Bros. deal that fell through.
